title: Joel And Kerri — EN/ES/FR (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone alto duet 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Spanish French heritage farm love
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Joel and Kerri built their life on red Zimbabwe clay
They planted every seed by hand and watched the seasons play
Two countries in their hearts but one beneath their feet
The farm was never easy but the farm was never beat

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
Joel y Kerri sembraron su vida en la tierra roja
[Joel and Kerri sowed their life in the red earth]
Dos corazones, una granja, una misma historia
[Two hearts, one farm, one shared story]
El polvo se levanta cuando el sol cae al suelo
[The dust rises when the sun falls to the ground]
Pero sus raíces están profundas, firmes bajo el cielo
[But their roots are deep, firm beneath the sky]

[Chorus — English]
Joel and Kerri, hand in hand
Standing on the red dust of their land
Joel and Kerri, year by year
Love that grows like crops when rain is near

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Joel et Kerri ont construit leur vie ensemble
[Joel and Kerri built their life together]
Sur la terre rouge du Zimbabwe qui ressemble
[On the red earth of Zimbabwe that resembles]
À un rêve de deux cœurs qui ne font qu'un
[A dream of two hearts that become one]
Leurs mains travaillent la terre, matin et soir sans fin
[Their hands work the earth, morning and night without end]

[Outro — All three languages]
Joel and Kerri… Joel y Kerri… Joel et Kerri
Two hearts, one farm — Dos corazones, una granja — Deux cœurs, une ferme
The gardens still growing
